slide3_topic_title: 当债券不再扮演债券：60/40股债平衡组合是否已死？
monthly_conflict_calibration: 长端美债收益率与固收资产校准：研报强调警惕长端美债与久期风险，本组合坚持纯股票高增长架构配搭大华黄金与富敦绝对收益底仓，规避了传统60/40组合在股债正相关环境下的减震失效陷阱。

manager_input.qualitative_view: 【正向论据 70%】美联储降息50基点叠加国内刺激，流动性拐点确立；股债正相关常态下，组合坚守纯股票成长、富敦绝对收益底仓与大华黄金三支柱，成立以来累计回报+81.16%，超额收益+12.49%。【反方审视 30%】尽管长端美债收益率反弹与地缘摩擦令当月净值微调1.21%，但回撤主要源于科技与A股短期估值消化，核心盈利逻辑稳固，维持全员持有定力。
manager_input.qualitative_view_en: [Supporting Evidence 70%] Following the 50 bps rate cut and domestic stimulus, a global liquidity inflection is firmly established; amid persistent positive stock-bond correlations, the portfolio adheres to its three-pillar all-equity growth, Fullerton market-neutral core, and United Gold hedge architecture, delivering +81.16% cumulative return and +12.49% alpha since inception. [Counter-Arguments 30%] Although rebounding long-end Treasury yields and geopolitical friction caused a minor 1.21% monthly pullback, the dip reflects temporary valuation digestion rather than fundamental decay, warranting a firm HOLD verdict across all 7 funds.
manager_input.rebalance_note: 各标的底层逻辑稳固，偏离度在安全阈值内，9月维持既有目标配比不变。
manager_input.rebalance_note_en: Core asset theses remain solid; weighting drifts sit comfortably within safety bands. Existing target allocations for all 7 funds remain unchanged for September.
